title: Mirror Neurons Are Why We Feel "On The Same Wavelength"...
subtitle: Human brains built from fish hardware.
body_html:
I’ve been making some video content. I even have a youtube channel cause…ok, I guess. People love video. I stopped fighting it.

This video explains—in 1:30— the role of mirror neurons in human behavior.
